input.summary: Make Vendor's appointment non-exclusive and confirm Customer may source elsewhere
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot commit to Copperleaf as our sole and exclusive provider for the full term, so we have made the appointment non-exclusive; this also removes the conflict with Section 12.3, which already confirms we have given no exclusivity commitment. If some exclusivity is important to you, we could discuss a 12-month term limited to hosted analytics that ends automatically if service levels or delivery dates are missed.

ops.oldText: 2.2 Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term.
ops.newText: 2.2 Vendor's appointment is non-exclusive. Customer may obtain hosted analytics services, or any other products or services, from any third party at any time.
